cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll accept a rematch with real terms: your captaincy against my place on the team. Put both beside the score before we start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's a ridiculous risk. One bad game could change everything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. You may call it a bad game afterward, but we'll both know which result changed the team.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Isn't pride enough? We could just announce the winner at dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Announce the terms at dinner instead; we'll play tomorrow. We've forgotten six games played for pride. Let everyone hear which role each of us is risking before we compete. Tomorrow's announcement will have something to settle.
